title: Heuristics: Eva-4B for evasion detection; DO NOT add acoustic features to earnings call NLP
rationale: Two complementary findings from the April 2026 dream cycle scan: (1) Eva-4B is a superior purpose-built evasion classifier for earnings Q&A; (2) Acoustic features HURT earnings call NLP models due to 'acoustic camouflage' — executives trained to suppress vocal stress indicators. Both findings have practical implications for R28 and R31 design.
content:
### Eva-4B as evasion classifier for earnings Q&A (upgrade from ad-hoc NOR detection)
- LESSON: Eva-4B (HuggingFace: `FutureMa/Eva-4B-V2`, Apache 2.0, 4B params) achieves 84.9% Macro-F1 on earnings call evasion detection — outperforming Claude Opus 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash. Use it instead of ad-hoc 3-step LLM prompting for NOR rate computation in EarningsQualityAgent.
- LESSON: Eva-4B outputs 3 classes: 'direct', 'intermediate', 'fully_evasive'. NOR_rate = fraction of (intermediate + fully_evasive) answers per call. Threshold >25% = position amplifier (consistent with arXiv:2505.18419 heuristic already in pool).
- LESSON: 40pp rise in evasion incoherence → 0.74% drop in 1-day returns; 63% likelihood of underperformance within 180 days for high-evasion companies (EvasionBench paper). Evasion is a bearish signal, NOT a PEAD amplifier — use as a VETO above NOR_rate > 0.50 combined with high evasion.
- WHEN: R28 EarningsQualityAgent Q&A scoring. Any pipeline that detects managerial evasion, non-responses, or deflection in earnings calls.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2601.09142 (EvasionBench, Jan 2026). GitHub: IIIIQIIII/EvasionBench. HF: FutureMa/Eva-4B-V2.

### Acoustic camouflage: do NOT add prosodic/speech features to earnings call NLP
- LESSON: Acoustic/prosodic features from earnings calls (pitch, speaking rate, vocal stress) DEGRADE NLP model performance due to 'acoustic camouflage': executives trained in media communication suppress natural stress indicators. Adding acoustic features to an NLP-only model drops recall from 66.25% to 47.08%.
- LESSON: Do NOT attempt multimodal (text + audio) earnings call analysis. NLP-only is strictly better. The 'voice stress analysis' intuition is wrong for media-trained corporate speakers.
- WHEN: Designing any earnings call ML pipeline (R28, R31, any future). Reject any proposal to add audio features.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2604.14619 (Acoustic Camouflage Phenomenon, April 2026)
